style.direction: vintage editorial illustration, Japanese archive print, mid-century modern graphic, handmade risograph artwork, museum specimen sheet
texture: local worn edges and ink skips

food.preserve: food identity, vessel shape, arrangement, original composition, and colour relationships
food.composition: show the complete food or vessel group with abundant quiet negative space; never a full-bleed ecommerce hero shot

beverage.preserve: drink identity, container silhouette, liquid colour, arrangement, and original composition
beverage.composition: show the complete drink or vessel group with abundant quiet negative space; never a full-bleed ecommerce hero shot

landscape.coverage: organic illustrated scene occupies 35-50%; off-white textured paper occupies 50-65% and remains asymmetrically distributed
landscape.preserve: landforms, scene perspective, natural contours, and colour relationships
landscape.composition: do not create a rectangular photo frame or a full-bleed landscape; use an organic irregular silhouette, asymmetric open space, local extension, and local dissolution on off-white paper

architecture.coverage: medium-scale organic brush-print field occupies 50-60%; off-white textured paper occupies 40-50% and remains visibly distributed
architecture.preserve: building geometry, perspective, structural rhythm, and colour relationships
architecture.composition: do not create a rectangular photo frame or a full-bleed architecture scene; place a compact structure study on off-white paper, use an organic irregular silhouette around real edges with asymmetric open space

portrait.preserve: facial identity, body structure, pose, clothing relationships, and original framing
portrait.composition: keep the figure complete and calm within the source composition; do not make a beauty-retouch or fashion-ad hero crop

product.preserve: product silhouette, material cues, structure, functional details, and readable label details
product.composition: show the complete product with measured negative space; do not create an oversized advertising pack shot
